name: Rewrite texts to bypass plagiarism and AI detection tools
description: Users asked the AI to rewrite or paraphrase specific texts to lower similarity scores, bypass plagiarism detection software, or evade AI content detectors. The requests often involved maintaining the original meaning while significantly altering the wording to achieve high uniqueness ratings for academic, technical, or professional documents.
